SELECT ahv.text_ as dept_name, a.lc_version, a.lc_name, a.lc_key, a.def_id, a.inst_id, aht.name_ as node_name, u.nick_name as assignee_name, aht.START_TIME_ as start_time, aht.END_TIME_ as end_time, aht.DURATION_ as duration FROM ( SELECT t.PROC_INST_ID_ as inst_id, DEF.VERSION_ as lc_version, rp.name_ as lc_name, rp.key_ as lc_key, t.PROC_DEF_ID_ as def_id FROM ACT_HI_taskinst t JOIN ACT_HI_VARINST RES ON RES.PROC_INST_ID_ = t.PROC_INST_ID_ AND RES.NAME_ = 'processStatus' AND res.text_ = 'completed' JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF rp ON rp.id_ = t.PROC_DEF_ID_
AND rp.key_ = #{lcKey}
AND t.PROC_INST_ID_ = #{instId}
JOIN ACT_RE_PROCDEF DEF ON t.PROC_DEF_ID_ = DEF.ID_ GROUP BY t.PROC_INST_ID_, rp.name_, rp.key_, t.PROC_DEF_ID_ ) a LEFT JOIN ACT_HI_taskinst aht ON aht.PROC_INST_ID_ = a.inst_id AND aht.DURATION_ IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = aht.assignee_ LEFT JOIN act_hi_varinst ahv ON ahv.PROC_INST_ID_ = a.inst_id AND ahv.TASK_ID_ IS NULL AND ahv.name_ = 'deptNameNew'
and ahv.text_ like concat('%',#{deptName},'%')
and u.nick_name like concat('%',#{assigneeName},'%')
and aht.name_ like concat('%',#{nodeName},'%')
ORDER BY a.inst_id, aht.START_TIME_

SELECT RES.id_ as modelId, res.name_ as modelName, res.key_ as modelKey from ACT_RE_MODEL RES WHERE RES.VERSION_ = (select max(VERSION_) from ACT_RE_MODEL where KEY_ = RES.KEY_) order by RES.CREATE_TIME_ desc
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ACT_HI_PROCINST WHERE DATE_FORMAT(START_TIME_,'%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m')
